name: talkie_fidelity
description: Yes/no fidelity scores for a talkie reword. Paragraph questions are batched, one set per candidate. Localise questions are one call for the chosen paragraph. Jev returns probabilities only.

dropped.instructions: Does `rewrites[{n}]` leave out any fact, physical detail, action, piece of spoken content, or emotional beat that is in `source`?

criteria.true: At least one thing stated in `source` (an object, detail, action, what someone says, or what someone feels) is absent from the rewrite.
criteria.false: Everything stated in `source` is present in the rewrite, even if worded or ordered differently.

invented.instructions: Does `rewrites[{n}]` add any person, object, action, event or circumstance that is not in `source` or `before`?

criteria.true: The rewrite adds something new that happens, exists or is said, which `source` does not contain.
criteria.false: The rewrite adds nothing beyond wording, order, small connecting words, or obvious implications of `source`.

contradiction.instructions: Does anything in `rewrites[{n}]` contradict `source`, i.e. state the opposite or a different version of a fact (e.g. silent where source says creaking, seen where source says unseen)?

criteria.true: Some statement in the rewrite is incompatible with `source`.
criteria.false: Nothing in the rewrite conflicts with `source`.

name.instructions: Does `rewrites[{n}]` call any person or animal by a different name or title than `source`, or give an action or spoken line to a different character than `source` does?

criteria.true: A name is changed, or an action or line is attributed to the wrong character.
criteria.false: Every name and every speaker or actor matches `source`.

err.instructions: Look only at line s{line} of `rewrite` (other lines are context). Does line s{line} state something that is not in `source` (an invented person, object, action or event), contradict `source`, or call someone by a different name than `source`?

criteria.true: The line contains an invented, contradicting or misnamed element.
criteria.false: Everything in the line is supported by `source`.

miss.instructions: Look at line m{line} of `source`. Is any fact, detail, spoken content or feeling from line m{line} missing from the whole of `rewrite`?

criteria.true: Something from m{line} appears nowhere in `rewrite`.
criteria.false: Everything in m{line} is present somewhere in `rewrite`.
